name: petlibro-esphome-plaf109-ui
description: Small mobile-friendly remote for an ESPHome PLAF109..

scripts.build: tsc && tailwindcss -i css/tailwind.css -o build/.tw.css -m && esbuild build/.tw.css --bundle --minify --loader:.png=dataurl --outfile=build/style.css && rm build/.tw.css && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --minify --loader:.svg=text --outfile=build/app.js --format=esm --target=es2020
